# PageBlockTableCell

## Documentation

A cell of a [`PageBlockTable`](PageBlockTable.md).

### Parameters

- **`text`** ([`RichText`](RichText.md), *optional*)
  Cell text. If the text is None, then the cell must be invisible.

- **`is_header`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if it is a header cell.

- **`colspan`** (`int`, *optional*)
  The number of columns the cell spans; defaults to 1.

- **`rowspan`** (`int`, *optional*)
  The number of rows the cell spans; defaults to 1.

- **`align`** ([`PageBlockHorizontalAlignment`](../../enums/PageBlockHorizontalAlignment.md), *optional*)
  Horizontal cell content alignment; defaults to `LEFT`.

- **`valign`** ([`PageBlockVerticalAlignment`](../../enums/PageBlockVerticalAlignment.md), *optional*)
  Vertical cell content alignment; when sending, defaults to
  `MIDDLE`.
